versions.content: Standalone Documentation The standalone documentation pro- vides means to capture documentation independently of the structure of an AUTOSAR system. In order to achieve this, it extends the introduction by adding chapters, top- ics, visual tables, and generic parameter sets ( prms ). One could say, it wraps the DocumentationBlock in chapters, topics, tables. In addition to this, it allows to refer to AUTOSAR-Objects, which are the context of the documentation. It is also provided as Documentation which is an ARElement of its own rights allow- ing for a reference to the document's context.
